branding.tagline: Video courses that remember your place

hero.eyebrow: Video courses that remember your place
hero.title: Every lesson, sharp up to 4K.
hero.subtitle: Lessons stream at the best quality your connection can hold, pick up at the second you stopped, and play with the keyboard shortcuts you already know.
hero.footnote: Free to join · Pay per course in ₹ or $

items.title: Sharp at any speed
items.body: Every lesson is encoded into a ladder of qualities up to 4K. The player picks the best one your connection can hold and switches without stopping.

items.title: Resume to the second
items.body: Close the tab halfway through a lesson. Next time it opens where you stopped, and your dashboard shows what comes next.

items.title: Shortcuts you already know
items.body: Space or K to pause, J and L to skip ten seconds, F for fullscreen, T for theater mode. The same keys as YouTube.

items.title: Pay per course
items.body: No subscription. Buy a course once, in rupees or dollars. Free courses need no card.

items.title: Receipts by email
items.body: Every purchase sends a receipt to your inbox, and your history is always under Purchases.

items.title: Progress you can trust
items.body: A lesson counts as watched once you have played 90% of it. Nothing is counted that you didn't watch.

steps.title: Create a course
steps.body: Give it a title, a description and a price, or make it free.

steps.title: Add lessons
steps.body: Upload one video per lesson. Each is encoded for every screen size, with a poster frame, while you keep working.

steps.title: Publish
steps.body: A checklist confirms every lesson is ready. Publish, and the course appears in the catalogue.

items.question: Do I need a subscription?
items.answer: No. Each course has its own price, and free courses cost nothing. You pay once for a course.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Paid courses check out through our payment partner. You get an email receipt, and the purchase appears under Purchases.

items.question: What happens if my connection drops?
items.answer: The player lowers the quality instead of stopping, then climbs back up when the connection recovers.

items.question: Can I watch on my phone?
items.answer: Yes. Lessons play in any modern browser, including Safari on iPhone and iPad.

items.question: How do I start teaching?
items.answer: Create an account, then request instructor access from your dashboard. Once an admin approves it, Studio appears in your sidebar.
